scorecard: Management hit the FY25 EBITDA‑margin target but most forward‑looking promises lack verifiable data, leaving credibility mixed.
business: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is India’s premier aerospace and defence manufacturer, building combat aircraft such as the LCA Mark‑1A, trainer HTT‑40 and the Dhruv NG helicopter. It reports consolidated financials and highlights production‑capacity expansions and new platform milestones in its earnings calls.
bull: FY25 EBITDA margin hit 31% – exactly the 31% target
Q2 FY27 revenue grew 15% YoY, well above the 7% FY27 guidance
Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin surged to 36%, far exceeding the FY27 30‑31% goal
bear: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 23%, missing the 30‑31% target
Q4 FY26 revenue growth slowed to 2% YoY, indicating weakening momentum
Large‑scale capex and order‑book promises cannot be validated from disclosed cash‑flow or order data
